title: Sovereign AX Offline Intent Envelope v1 (relay queue; outer wire object, with the HPKE plaintext in $defs)
$comment: v1.3 new (AUDIT-C C-17/C-34, C/X-14). D08 §7. Only the outer object {v, kind, enc, ct} is visible to the relay. pair_id, seq and exp live inside the HPKE plaintext. HPKE Base (RFC 9180) mode, suite selected by 'v' (v=1: DHKEM(X25519, HKDF-SHA256), HKDF-SHA256, ChaCha20-Poly1305; v=2 reserved for X-Wing hybrid). pkR = recipient desktop Q_D from a non-expired, seq-monotonic mailbox bundle (SAX-qbundle-v1); info = 'SAX-env-v1'; aad = 'SAX-env-v1' || mbx_epoch (8-byte big-endian). Binary fields are base64 here, CBOR bytes on the wire.

v.$comment: suite identifier; 2 reserved for X-Wing (ML-KEM-768 + X25519)

enc.$comment: HPKE encapsulated key (32 bytes for v=1)

ct.$comment: HPKE ciphertext of CBOR(#/$defs/plaintext), padded to the D08 §6 bucket sizes before sealing

plaintext.$comment: HPKE plaintext. sig = Sign_Vm('SAX-env-v1' || canonical-CBOR(intent)). The PC verifies sig with the phone's Vm from an AIK-signed device list, then checks exp, seq window, cmd_id not yet processed, playbook whitelist and the playbook input schema.

iat.$comment: seconds since epoch; shown on the start-gate card as 'N hours ago'

exp.$comment: exp - iat <= queue.ttlHours * 3600 (72 h = 259200 s); validator rejects otherwise (C/X-14)

inputs.$comment: Must validate against the installed playbook's input schema (playbook IR inputs). Any field marked x-secret:true in that schema is forbidden here. Counterparties are referenced by local counterparty ID (counterpartyRef) rather than business number or e-mail where the playbook allows (C-34).

intent_hash.$comment: SHA-256(CBOR{cmd_id, playbookId, playbookMajor, inputs}). Not the gate actionHash (which is readback-based and computed at execution time).

qbundle_seq.$comment: seq of the Q_D bundle used to seal; must be >= the highest bundle seq the phone has seen

anyOf.$comment: flat record, e.g. H-01 amounts {supply, tax}
array of flat records, e.g. H-01 items (line_items)
